title: security: RBAC v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening for Private deployments
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning checks during RBAC v2 role evaluation for Private deployments; improved audit logs for KMS-backed keys; migration guide added.
description: Context: Private deployments require stricter enforcement of KMS region residency for customer-managed keys to meet regulatory contracts and internal compliance (ENG-1382). Previously RBAC v2 exposed KMS region pinning only in audit mode which allowed misconfigured keys to slip into production. This change introduces enforcement mode for region pinning during RBAC v2 policy evaluation, plus richer audit logs for all KMS operations to improve post-incident forensics and automated alerts. Motivations: reduce accidental cross-region key usage, provide deterministic RBAC deny decisions early in request flow, and surface KMS residency info in audit events for legal/compliance teams. What this PR does: 1) Adds a KMS residency policy evaluator that runs during RBAC v2 evaluation; 2) Introduces an explicit enforcement toggle on the Private control plane (private.config.enforce_kms_region_pinning) defaulting to false for initial rollout; 3) Enhances audit log schema with kms.key_region, kms.key_alias, kms.policy_match, and decision_reason fields; 4) Adds migration guide + Linear checklist for operators; 5) Adds unit and integration tests covering policy permutations and fallback behavior when a compatible key variant is available. Rollout plan & compatibility: Start in audit-only mode (no behavior change) via config. Enable enforcement for 10% of hosts with canary flag, monitor audit logs and alert thresholds (SLOs: zero denials for 48h from misconfig). If stable, increase to 100% and update default config to enforce=true. Backward compatibility: when enforcement is enabled and a request references an incompatible key, request is denied with a clear 403 and structured error (error.code=KMS_REGION_MISMATCH). Operators can configure automatic fallback routing to a compatible KMS key variant via policy mapping. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for evaluator - [x] Integration tests (KMS emulator) - [x] Migration guide in docs - [x] Console flag + config UI updates - [x] Add metric kms_region_pin_denials - [x] Alert runbook updated Related: ENG-1382, SEC-542, SUP-321. Docs: https://redwood.docs/internal/security/kms-region-pinning Migration: see docs/migrations/kms-region-pinning.md. Note: this PR touches both control plane RBAC logic and Private installer hooks; reviewers should pay attention to potential latency impact in policy eval path and to audit log schema compatibility with existing retention pipelines.
